title: Pure SATFLOW task-4 derivative update equation

source.behavior: Update macropore-flow derivative from outgoing-minus-incoming SATFLOW terms when absolute head difference exceeds 1e-14, then apply the covering-top-compartment incoming-flow correction when matrix head exceeds zero.

scope: explicit input/output derivative and saved head-difference vectors
non_goals: solver Jacobian assembly, accepted mass receipt, retry/restart or runtime admission
